# fetchloom

> fetchloom is uv for research data on windows and linux. data.toml is the shopping list, data.lock is the receipt pinning every file by SHA-256 and size, and the shared content-addressed cache is the pantry. `fetchloom sync` places those files in data/ by reflink, then hardlink, then copy where supported.

## docs

- [README](README.md): install, quick start, source examples, everyday commands and troubleshooting
- [cli](docs/cli.md): every command, option and output, plus archives, cache and environment settings
- [agents](docs/agents.md): --json recipes, error kinds, exit codes, the python helper and offline use
- [formats](docs/formats.md): data.toml, data.lock, cache records, environment settings and the JSON contract
